ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Garware Technical Fibres Limited (GTFL) - Q1 FY27 Financials**  Garware Technical Fibres Limited posted strong consolidated results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with revenue from operations growing 31.3% year-over-year to Rs 48,237.27 lakhs and net profit attributable to owners rising 21.6% to Rs 6,460.30 lakhs. A significant material impact was a substantial increase in Other Comprehensive Income, which contributed to a robust total comprehensive income for the period. The report indicates solid operational performance with no immediate red flags.
